Section A, new, from the Orbits recipe. Orbits, with fireflies on stabs and hits. A geodesic sphere is the centrepiece. The cosmos: the camera flies with the track, drawn in by builds and let go on drops, each section on the galaxy arm that suits it. The glow flies behind the planets. Sparkles pop on the stabs. Changes fade in. Colours: opposites. Pace: steady, pulsing every other beat.
